archetypes.name: dyn-self-review-tally
archetypes.rationale: Changed self-review tally counts from caller-supplied flags to artifact-derived regex counts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new write-self-review-tally behavior and tests. Focus on whether accepted and rejected headings are counted with the intended prefix and exact-match semantics. Check that missing or empty artifacts produce zero and that removing the CLI flags leaves prompt, docs, and run-log behavior consistent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
